subject: C004 human-requested internet research
body: Human requests precautions and conceptual information from the internet beyond the PDF. D is implementing bounded xAI native web search, independently verified short source excerpts and separate web links. Optional request webResearch=true adds webSources/webCitations/researchStatus; omitted flag retains original wire shape for already-open clients. C004 records direct human authority without inferred ACKs. Search uses only fixed public topic labels and trusted domains; exact handout quotes and fixed emergency routing remain. Tests skipped under human instruction; production build and targeted live diagnostics follow.
